Cancer surveillance and other recommende.When / how often: Every 3-6 months for the first 3 years, every 6-12 months for the next 2 years, and annually thereafter
Cancer surveillance and other recommende.Explanation: Regular detailed cancer-related history and physical examination are essential for early detection of disease recurrence and monitoring of the patient's overall health status.

Cancer surveillance and other recommende.When / how often: As needed to monitor for diabetes
Cancer surveillance and other recommende.Explanation: Given the patient's history of prediabetes, regular monitoring of blood glucose and Hemoglobin A1C is necessary to rule out diabetes and manage the patient's metabolic health.

Cancer surveillance and other recommende.Test type: Regular pelvic exams, breast exams, and mammograms
Cancer surveillance and other recommende.When / how often: Regularly as part of routine follow-up care
Cancer surveillance and other recommende.Explanation: Patients on selective estrogen receptor modulator therapies (SERMs) like Tamoxifen should have regular pelvic exams, breast exams, and mammograms to monitor for potential side effects and secondary cancers.
Postmenopausal women on SERMs should receive an annual gynecologic assessment to monitor for any signs of endometrial cancer.
